user.title: EnOcean PTM 216B BLE
user.description: Add the passive EnOcean PTM 216B BLE observer. This creates a single observation-only entry; no pairing, commissioning, or key entry happens here.

reconfigure.title: Manual capture
reconfigure.description: Choose a bounded, manually started diagnostic capture. To commission a switch, use this integration's device page's "Add switch" instead -- that is now a per-switch Add-device wizard (config subentry), not part of this menu. Setup and passive observation never start any of these on their own.

abort.designation_capture_started: Designation capture started. Watch the Designation capture sensor for the baseline, press, and confirmation phases.
abort.evidence_capture_started: Evidence capture started. Watch the Evidence capture sensor during the 90-second collecting window.
abort.no_designated_device: No device has been designated yet in this session. Run designation capture first, then start evidence capture again.

user.title: Add a switch
user.description: Detect the switch by pressing it (recommended -- this cross-checks the address you enter next against a real press, so a typo cannot commission the wrong switch), or skip detection and enter its QR/label text or address/key directly.

detect_failed.title: No switch was uniquely detected
detect_failed.description: Detection ended without selecting exactly one switch -- either nothing was pressed, more than one candidate matched, or the two press windows did not agree. Try detection again, or continue without it.

key_entry_detected.title: Enter the switch's key
key_entry_detected.description: Detection succeeded. Enter the QR/label text, upload a photo of the label, or fill in the address and security key manually -- the address you provide is cross-checked against the switch you just pressed. Never paste this material anywhere except this form -- not into chat, GitHub issues, or Git. {qr_status}

key_entry_manual.title: Enter the switch's key
key_entry_manual.description: Detection was skipped, so there is no cross-check against a physical press -- a typo in the address or key will silently commission the wrong switch (or none at all). Enter the QR/label text, upload a photo of the label, or fill in the address and security key manually. Never paste this material anywhere except this form -- not into chat, GitHub issues, or Git. {qr_status}

reconfigure.title: Edit switch
reconfigure.description: Change this switch's name, rocker count, or long-press threshold. This never re-commissions the switch -- its address and security key are unaffected and cannot be entered here.

progress.detect_baseline: Keep this and every other EnOcean switch quiet for a few seconds while a quiet baseline is established.
progress.detect_press: Press the switch three times, about two seconds apart, on the one button you want to detect.
progress.detect_confirmation: Repeat the same three presses on the same button, to confirm.

error.invalid_commissioning_data: Could not read an address, security key, and name from the photo, QR/label text, or the manual fields. Check the photo/QR text, or fill in the address, the 32-character security key, and a name.
error.switch_already_commissioned: This switch is already commissioned. Remove its existing subentry first if you want to re-commission it under a new name.

abort.designation_mismatch: The entered address does not match the switch detected in this wizard. Go back and detect the same physical switch, or continue without detection.
